annotations.free_answer: Needs a free key (claim_free_key). No paid plan required.
annotations.title: Report Finding

description: PARTNER KEY ONLY: file what you observed on a DC Hub surface as a brain finding (detector external_audit) so it is triaged like every other detector's. class is one of completeness_contradiction, geography_leak, as_of_cite_as, pro_wall_dead_end, count_drift, stale_payload_complete, leak_past_pro_gate, link_hygiene, other; tool names the DC Hub tool or endpoint; quoted_fields carries the exact fields you saw (hashed for dedupe: the same observation re-filed within 24h bumps recurrence instead of inserting). Proxies POST /api/v1/inbox/findings with the session's own key; a key issued without a partner slug answers partner key required (403). 120 per key per day.

args.description: The arguments you called it with

class.description: Finding class: completeness_contradiction (status full/partial_preview with empty withheld_fields), geography_leak (preview resolved outside the requested ISO/region), as_of_cite_as (as_of null while cite_as stamps a date), pro_wall_dead_end (a paid-plan wall that says stop while next_ask offers another paid-plan tool and no cheaper rung), count_drift (tool or asset counts disagree across doors), stale_payload_complete (a stale sub-feed inside a payload marked complete), leak_past_pro_gate (a paid-plan field served below its plan), link_hygiene (dead or wrong-shape links), other

note.description: One or two sentences of context

quoted_fields.description: The exact fields/values you observed (object, list or string); hashed for dedupe

recurrence.description: How many times you have seen it (default 1)

tool.description: The DC Hub tool or endpoint the finding is about, e.g. analyze_site

name: report_finding

outputSchema.description: DC Hub envelope: tool data fields ride at the top level beside these keys.

_front_door.description: First-tool hint: plan_query(intent) returns the ordered plan.

citation.description: How to attribute DC Hub: {source, url, license, cite_as, retrieved_at}, or the attribution line as a string.

provenance.description: Source, method, as_of, verification_counts, license, cite_as; quote it when citing.

site_evaluation_handoff.description: Follow-up calls [{tool, parameters, why}] when the payload carries coordinates.

title: Report Finding
